decisions.question: What should change?
decisions.chosen: Clear the 14 pre-existing design_check findings in index.html: remove the .card:before stripe; restyle kbd's 2px bottom border as an inset box-shadow; make the .disc disclaimer 12px in #75624e (5.03:1 on #f6eedd)
decisions.rationale: design_check exits 2 on main, so every UI checkpoint's design gate fails. impeccable can only waive these rules file-wide ('*'), which would also hide future real findings, so fix rather than waive. User chose remove-stripe and restyle-keycap.

decisions.question: How do we know it is done?
decisions.chosen: npx --yes impeccable@4 detect --quiet client index.html exits 0 with no ignores config and no inline waivers; npm test passes, including a test that the disclaimer is >=12px and >=4.5:1 contrast against --paper
decisions.rationale: The detector is the gate's own check; the unit test guards the one real accessibility defect in the offline test suite.
